outcome: Association between Fear of Birth and depressive symptoms
cohort: Postnatal women in Chhattisgarh, India, who gave birth vaginally or via C-section to a live neonate
finding: The study found a strong association between Fear of Birth and postnatal depressive symptoms, with prevalence rates of 13.1% and 17.1%, respectively.
mod_finding: Among women having vaginal births: coming for institutional births due to health professionals' advice, giving birth in a district hospital and having postnatal depressive symptoms were associated with presence of FoB.
